Apple updated the privacy policy of its Apple Store app, adding terms related to an upcoming virtual shopping assistant. Here are the details.

Apple is expanding the use of AI in its retail business

According to a discovery by MacRumors, a section titled "Virtual Shopping Assistant" has been added to the Apple Store app and its privacy page, which mentions:

In other words, the Apple Store app is likely to incorporate a chatbot that delivers personalised responses based on user data to help users make purchase decisions.

Apple says that personally identifiable information will be stripped before conversations are shared with unnamed partners responsible for powering the assistant's replies, a practice that seems to suggest at least part of the experience will rely on third-party models provided by external companies.

Conversation records will be kept within the app for users to browse, and will also be retained for Apple to conduct business analytics. Users may separately choose whether to allow their conversations to be used for improving the Virtual Shopping Assistant, an option called "Chat Improvements".

The wording of Apple's privacy policy indicates that the virtual assistant will initially only be available in selected countries or regions, and may launch first in English-speaking markets before being rolled out to other languages and regions.

This news comes a few months after Apple added an AI chatbot to its Sales Coach app, which provides sales and technical resources to Apple's retail partners. Users can access the chatbot through the "Ask" tab, where it answers questions based on Apple's official training materials and documentation.

This news also comes on the heels of a Bloomberg report that Apple is testing a system called "Live Notes" in select retail stores, which uses AI to record, transcribe and summarise Genius Bar support conversations, allowing employees to focus on helping customers without having to stop and take notes.

To learn more about the Apple Store app and its privacy policy, please visit the following link.
